result.title: Standing on the Shoulders of Giants: Enhancing LLM Agents for Automated Fact-Checking with Human Expert Skills
result.summary: Automated fact-checking (AFC) systems powered by large language model (LLM) agents still face challenges in evidence retrieval and claim verification. Existing approaches improve their capabilities through computationally costly post-training or human-in-the-loop feedback that is difficult to scale. To transfer professional fact-checking expertise to LLM agents efficiently, we distill publicly available guidelines published by Agence France-Presse (AFP) Fact Check into a reusable, modular Professional Fact-Checking Skill (PFC-Skill). We then present SkillCheck, the first AFC system that gives LLM agents dynamic access to PFC-Skill to guide evidence retrieval and claim verification at inference time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SkillCheck improves upon skill-free DEFAME baselines across multiple LLM backbones, with gains of 2.2--4.8 pp. in Accuracy and 1.5--6.3 pp. in Macro-F1 on the AVeriTeC benchmark. Notably, SkillCheck with GPT-4o-Mini exceeds DEFAME with GPT-4o by 3.4 pp. in Accuracy while cutting inference cost by roughly 61%. The performance gains also extend to open-web retrieval. Ablations show that incorporating the skill during evidence retrieval provides most of the gains, while incorporation into both stages yields the best overall performance. Case studies show that PFC-Skill enables more targeted search and closer scrutiny of evidence. To conclude, our work shows that LLM agents can "stand on the shoulders of giants" by drawing on the best practices of professional fact-checkers, substantially enhancing AFC performance without extra training or continuous human supervision.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把 AFP 公开的事实核查指南蒸馏为模块化的「PFC-Skill」，并构建 SkillCheck：在推理期让 LLM agent 动态调用该技能来引导证据检索与论断验证，在 AVeriTeC 上无需额外训练即取得准确率与 Macro-F1 提升，并降低推理成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「推理期动态接入外部专家技能、并分别作用于检索与验证阶段」的设计，以及关于增益主要来自检索阶段的消融，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK 步骤的证据筛选与阶段贡献分配提供可核查线索；但该工作是纯文本事实核查，不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理，迁移性需自行判断。
